29void UEardarEmitterComponent::BeginPlay()
30{
31 Super::BeginPlay();
32
33 /*
34 * Find the E.A.R.D.A.R. manager placed in the current level.
35 *
36 * TActorIterator searches through actors of the requested type.
37 * The prototype expects a single AEardarManager instance, so the
38 * search stops after the first valid manager is found.
39 */
40 if (UWorld* World = GetWorld())
41 {
42 for (TActorIterator<AEardarManager> It(World); It; ++It)
43 {
44 AEardarManager* Manager = *It;
45
46 if (Manager)
47 {
48 // Register this component as an active E.A.R.D.A.R. sound source.
49 Manager->RegisterEmitter(this);
50
51 // Only one manager is required for the current prototype.
52 break;
53 }
54 }
55 }
56}

67void UEardarEmitterComponent::EndPlay(const EEndPlayReason::Type EndPlayReason)
68{
69 /*
70 * Remove this emitter from the manager when the actor or component
71 * leaves the world.
72 *
73 * This prevents the manager from retaining references to objects that
74 * are no longer active.
75 */
76 if (UWorld* World = GetWorld())
77 {
78 for (TActorIterator<AEardarManager> It(World); It; ++It)
79 {
80 AEardarManager* Manager = *It;
81
82 if (Manager)
83 {
84 Manager->UnregisterEmitter(this);
85 break;
86 }
87 }
88 }
89
90 Super::EndPlay(EndPlayReason);
91}

103FVector UEardarEmitterComponent::GetEmitterLocation() const
104{
105 // Prefer the AudioComponent's location if supplied for spatialised sounds.
106 if (AudioComponent)
107 {
108 return AudioComponent->GetComponentLocation();
109 }
110
111 // Fall back to the owning actor's location.
112 return GetOwner() ? GetOwner()->GetActorLocation() : FVector::ZeroVector;
113};
